# Dre Dyson

> > A technical resource hub by founder Dre Dyson focused on AI pair programming, Cursor IDE optimization, and developer productivity strategies for career growth.

Dre Dyson's website combines practical troubleshooting guides, technical deep-dives, and strategic career advice for developers leveraging AI tools. The site emphasizes cost optimization, performance tuning, and monetization strategies using modern development tools like Cursor IDE and Claude.

## Key Topics

- Cursor IDE
- AI pair programming
- Claude 4.6 Opus
- Git workflow
- Developer productivity
- Consulting rates
- Cost optimization

- Python

- Technical due diligence
